2609.08592.title: A Three-Tier Persona Vector for Controllable User Simulation in Agentic Evaluation
2609.08592.paper_summary: Evaluating tool-augmented LLM agents requires diverse, realistic user inputs yet most evaluation frameworks use flat role descriptions ("you are an angry customer") that produce near-identical conversations regardless of the underlying scenario. In this paper, we propose a three-tier persona vector with 23 operationalized dimensions: 6 categorical demographics (jurisdiction, age, channel, device, language proficiency, time availability), 12 continuous behavioral traits (patience, assertiveness, digital literacy, etc.) sampled with Gaussian noise around curated profile base vectors, and 5 continuous emotional states (frustration, anxiety, trust, confidence, stress) that shift in response to scenario context. Orthogonal to the persona, a 4-level query-complexity overlay controls utterance phrasing from direct to deliberately vague. We evaluate the persona model inside a synthetic data generation pipeline across 64,698 multi-turn conversations spanning 8 named profiles and 3 production corpora. Key findings: (i) a 15.8 percentage-point spread in agent goal-achievement across personas confirms trait vectors produce measurably different user behavior; (ii) the same persona behaves differently across scenarios due to scenario-reactive emotional state shifts, validating the scenario-reactive design; (iii) domain-specific projects show persona sensitivity on booking-flow compliance (~15-20 percentage points gap between tier-aware and pressure-test personas), demonstrating the model faithfully reproduces real-world difficulty distributions; (iv) seven rule-described trait correlations produce auditable co-occurrence patterns without requiring learned covariance matrices. The persona model is fully specified for reproduction.
2609.08592.paper_summary_zh: 評估工具增強的 LLM 代理需要多樣化、現實的用戶輸入，但大多數評估框架使用平面的角色描述（「你是一位憤怒的顧客」），這會產生幾乎相同的對話，無論底層情境如何。在本文中，我們提出了一個三層次的人格向量，包含 23 個具體化的維度：6 個類別人口統計（管轄區、年齡、渠道、設備、語言能力、時間可用性）、12 個連續行為特徵（耐心、自信、數位素養等），這些特徵在策劃的基礎向量周圍取樣，並加入高斯噪聲，以及 5 個連續情感狀態（挫折、焦慮、信任、自信、壓力），這些狀態會根據情境背景而變化。與人格無關的，4 級查詢複雜度覆蓋層控制從直接到故意模糊的話語措辭。我們在一個合成數據生成管道中評估人格模型，涵蓋 64,698 個多輪對話，橫跨 8 個命名的個人檔案和 3 個生產語料庫。主要發現：（i）不同人格之間的代理目標達成率有 15.8 個百分點的差距，確認特徵向量產生可測量的不同用戶行為；（ii）相同的人格在不同情境下的行為不同，這是由於情境反應的情感狀態變化，驗證了情境反應設計；（iii）特定領域的項目顯示出人格對預訂流程合規性的敏感性（層次感知和壓力測試人格之間約有 15-20 個百分點的差距），證明該模型忠實地再現了現實世界的難度分佈；（iv）七個規則描述的特徵相關性產生可審計的共現模式，而不需要學習的協方差矩陣。人格模型已完全指定以供重現。
